title: Makebelieve
overview: Coming of age drama focusing on the loves, lives, and infidelities of four college friends, all while working in a production of Romeo and Juliet.  (Note: This early work is not currently known to be publicly available for viewing.)

title: Ghosts of Hamilton Street
overview: In this award-winning student film, a troubled writer questions his sanity as people in his life vanish without a trace - and it seems he's the only one who realizes it. Each disappearance catapults him into a version of the world in which that person never existed at all, and once he realizes the specific order to this phenomenon, he must try to save the people he loves from forces he may never understand.  (Note: This early work is not currently known to be publicly available for viewing.)
tagline: What if everyone you love disappeared, and you were the only one who noticed? Brody Campbell's life is slipping away . . . one person at a time.

title: Oculus: Chapter 3 – The Man with the Plan
tmdbTitle: Oculus: Chapter 3 – The Man with the Plan
overview: A man sets out to prove an antique mirror is haunted.

title: Absentia
overview: Tricia's husband has been missing for seven years. Her younger sister Callie comes to live with her as the pressure mounts to finally declare him 'dead in absentia'. Tricia is reluctant, always holding out hope, but Callie is practical and wants her to move on. As Tricia sifts through the wreckage and tries to move on with her life, Callie finds herself drawn to an ominous tunnel near the house.
tagline: There are fates worse than death.

title: Oculus
overview: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.
tagline: You see what it wants you to see.

title: Before I Wake
overview: An orphaned child's dreams—and nightmares—manifest physically as he sleeps.

title: Hush
overview: A deaf woman is stalked by a psychotic killer in her secluded home.

title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
overview: In 1967 Los Angeles, a widowed mother and her two daughters add a new stunt to bolster their séance scam business and unwittingly invite authentic evil into their home. When the youngest daughter is overtaken by the merciless spirit, this small family confronts unthinkable fears to save her and send her possessor back to the other side.
tagline: When you talk to the other side, you never know who will be listening.

title: Gerald's Game
overview: When her husband's sex game goes wrong, Jessie (who is handcuffed to a bed in a remote lake house) faces warped visions, dark secrets and a dire choice.
tagline: Some games you play. Some you survive.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
overview: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.

episodes.name: Steven Sees a Ghost
episodes.overview: While investigating a ghost story for his latest novel, a skeptical Steven receives a call from his sister that triggers a chain of fateful events.

episodes.name: Open Casket
episodes.overview: A devastating family tragedy stirs memories of traumatic losses, reminding Shirley of her first brush with death -- and awakening long-dormant fears.

episodes.name: Touch
episodes.overview: Keenly perceptive Theo sees shades of herself in a troubled young patient, a girl who's haunted by the menacing grin of "Mr. Smiley."

episodes.name: The Twin Thing
episodes.overview: Still wrestling with addiction -- and an unshakable fright -- a frantic Luke tries to save a friend while sensing his twin sister is in danger.

episodes.name: The Bent-Neck Lady
episodes.overview: A dark specter with an unsettling silhouette has haunted Nell since she was a girl. Now "the Bent-Neck Lady" is back -- and she's calling Nell home.

episodes.name: Two Storms
episodes.overview: It's a reunion for all the wrong reasons when Hugh flies in for the funeral, coming face to face with his estranged children on a dark, stormy night.

episodes.name: Eulogy
episodes.overview: As the Crains gather to say their final goodbyes, a flashback reveals Mr. Dudley's connection to the house -- and exposes a secret in the walls.

episodes.name: Witness Marks
episodes.overview: A familiar terror revisits Shirley and Theo on Halloween night as Hugh and Steve go looking for Luke, who disappeared on a deadly errand.

episodes.name: Screaming Meemies
episodes.overview: While struggling to discern dreams from reality, Olivia fears for her children's safety, a motherly instinct Mrs. Dudley urges her to embrace.

episodes.name: Silence Lay Steadily
episodes.overview: The Red Room's contents are finally revealed as the Crains return to the house to confront old ghosts, unspeakable secrets and an insatiable evil.

title: Doctor Sleep
overview: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".

title: The Haunting of Bly Manor
overview: After an au pair's tragic death, Henry Wingrave hires a young American nanny to care for his orphaned niece and nephew who reside at Bly Manor with the estate's chef Owen, groundskeeper Jamie and housekeeper, Mrs. Grose. But all is not as it seems at the manor, and centuries of dark secrets of love and loss are waiting to be unearthed in this chilling tale.

episodes.name: The Great Good Place
episodes.overview: A bright-eyed American au pair hopes to make a difference caring for two orphans in a grand English manor. Yet the feeling of dread is undeniable.

episodes.name: The Pupil
episodes.overview: After experiencing a harrowing scare, Dani tries to teach the children a lesson. Still, the kids have an unsettling way of getting under one's skin.

episodes.name: The Two Faces (1)
episodes.overview: Dani and Miles get an uncanny glimpse of the past. Peter Quint, Rebecca Jessel and their twisted history cast a long shadow.

episodes.name: The Way It Came
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Dani is haunted by her own heartbreaking loss. Flora and Miles find ways to cope, and Bly's staff remember the dead over a bonfire.

episodes.name: The Altar of the Dead
episodes.overview: She's seen it all. The memories come flooding back for housekeeper Hannah Grose as she reflects on the living and dead trapped at Bly Manor.

episodes.name: The Jolly Corner
episodes.overview: In denial and embroiled in his work, Henry Wingrave must reckon with himself. Dani reaches out to Jamie while Flora gets lost in the past.

episodes.name: The Two Faces (2)
episodes.overview: Miles and Flora are pulled into a ghostly game. Faced with the facts, Rebecca comes to an unhappy conclusion, and Hannah makes a shattering discovery.

episodes.name: The Romance of Certain Old Clothes
episodes.overview: Bly's dark origins come to light. Once the iron-willed lady of the manor, Viola becomes consumed by a monstrous rage, ensnaring all souls around her.

episodes.name: The Beast in the Jungle
episodes.overview: The dream is done, yet danger prevails. Hannah summons the courage to act. A fate worse than death threatens everyone at Bly. Who will pay the price?

title: Midnight Mass
overview: The arrival of a charismatic young priest brings glorious miracles, ominous mysteries and renewed religious fervor to a dying town desperate to believe.

episodes.name: Book I: Genesis
episodes.overview: Riley Flynn returns home to family dysfunction, familiar faces and a new priest at St. Patrick's. Elsewhere on the island, a dark storm is brewing.

episodes.name: Book II: Psalms
episodes.overview: An unsettling omen washes ashore in the wake of the storm. Later, when the locals gather for a potluck, tragedy strikes — and a miracle occurs.

episodes.name: Book III: Proverbs
episodes.overview: Miraculous times leave residents stunned as Leeza pays Joe an important visit. A shocking confession reveals what really happened to Monsignor Pruitt.

episodes.name: Book IV: Lamentations
episodes.overview: Erin turns to Riley after receiving upsetting news. Father Paul starts experiencing disturbing side effects. Bev makes a startling discovery.

episodes.name: Book V: Gospel
episodes.overview: Sheriff Shabazz fields multiple missing persons reports as the town prepares to gather for Good Friday. To protect Erin, Riley brings the truth to light.

episodes.name: Book VI: Acts of the Apostles
episodes.overview: A fervent Bev calls for faith on the night of Easter vigil. Sarah reveals the results of a troubling experiment — along with a sobering hypothesis.

episodes.name: Book VII: Revelation
episodes.overview: Night falls on Crockett Island as a tight-knit group of rebels take refuge where they can and forge a plan to control the chaos.

title: The Midnight Club
overview: Inside a hospice for terminally ill teens, members of an exclusive club make a chilling pact: The first to die must send a sign from beyond the grave.
tagline: Death is a rite of passage.

episodes.name: The Final Chapter
episodes.overview: When cancer cancels her plans for college, star student Ilonka finds a sliver of hope at Brightcliffe, a mysterious hospice for terminally ill teens.

episodes.name: The Two Danas
episodes.overview: Anya brings bitterness to a tense group therapy session, and Ilonka meets a healer on the grounds. A deep cut sends a shaken Spencer to the infirmary

episodes.name: The Wicked Heart
episodes.overview: Family Day at Brightcliffe brings news from home — but not for everyone. A series of strange clues lead Ilonka down a path of startling discoveries.

episodes.name: Gimme a Kiss
episodes.overview: The club explores a hidden chamber, where Sandra's unsettled by items in the room. A voice calls to Spence through the intercom. Anya sees a dark shadow.

episodes.name: See You Later
episodes.overview: Ilonka digs deeper into Brightcliffe's mysteries — and receives an unexpected gift. Later that night, the club gathers for Amesh's "Death Day" party.

episodes.name: Witch
episodes.overview: With Anya's health hanging in the balance, Ilonka and the others move quickly to perform a ritual from the Midnight Club's past.

episodes.name: Anya
episodes.overview: Anya's eyes open to a strange new reality. Ilonka blames herself for a crushing loss... then overhears a conversation that could change everything.

episodes.name: Road to Nowhere
episodes.overview: Armed with new information, Ilonka is determined to find answers. Shasta extends an intriguing offer. The club convenes to find the library doors locked.

episodes.name: The Eternal Enemy
episodes.overview: Kevin confesses he's been seeing things. Dispiriting news sends Ilonka away from Brightcliffe, but an optimistic Shasta urges her to go back.

episodes.name: Midnight
episodes.overview: Dr. Stanton reprimands Ilonka the following morning, revealing more about Julia Jayne. Sandra says her goodbyes. At long last, Kevin concludes his story.

title: The Fall of the House of Usher
tmdbTitle: The Fall of the House of Usher
overview: To secure their fortune — and future — two ruthless siblings build a family dynasty that begins to crumble when their heirs mysteriously die, one by one.

episodes.name: A Midnight Dreary
episodes.overview: A wealthy CEO faces a criminal investigation amid tragedy, trauma — and a supernatural threat. The Usher family learns an informant lurks among them.

episodes.name: The Masque of the Red Death
episodes.overview: Motivated by money and revenge, Perry hosts an exclusive masque-rave that takes a twisted turn. A young Roderick pitches a revolutionary new opioid.

episodes.name: Murder in the Rue Morgue
episodes.overview: In charge of the Ushers' publicity, Camille conspires to spin controversy in her family's favor and expose the grim details of her sister's experiments.

episodes.name: The Black Cat
episodes.overview: Leo adopts a black cat who soon brings evil — and a mysterious woman — into his home, while Roderick struggles with terrifying hallucinations.

episodes.name: The Tell-Tale Heart
episodes.overview: Victorine inches closer to testing her heart technology on a patient until tensions erupt between her and Alessandra. Dupin makes a chilling confession.

episodes.name: Goldbug
episodes.overview: Pym digs up disturbing information on Verna. With her marriage on the decline, Tamerlane hosts a turbulent product launch that shatters expectations.

episodes.name: The Pit and the Pendulum
episodes.overview: A furious Frederick sets out to handle unfinished business. Madeline receives an ominous message at an old haunt. Dupin grows wary of Roderick's motives.

episodes.name: The Raven
episodes.overview: In 1980, Roderick and Madeline seize a chance to cement their fortune — for a price. Decades later, the remaining Ushers reckon with the consequences.

title: The Life of Chuck
overview: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.
tagline: Every life is a universe all its own.

title: Carrie
overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.
tagline: She just wanted a friend. They gave her a fight.

episodes.name: FIRST PERIOD
episodes.overview: The start of a brand new day.

episodes.name: FOREIGN LANGUAGE
episodes.overview: New communication skills from an unfamiliar culture.

episodes.name: SOCIAL STUDIES
episodes.overview: How people, communities, and societies interact.

episodes.name: DRAMATIC ARTS
episodes.overview: Voice, movement, and improvisation.

episodes.name: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
episodes.overview: Health, fitness, and exercise.

episodes.name: HOME ECONOMICS
episodes.overview: Practical life skills for independent living.

episodes.name: ROMANTIC LITERATURE
episodes.overview: The power of emotion and individual experience.

episodes.name: AP PHYSICS
episodes.overview: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
